{{Quote|It was to be.|The Voss, on the battle cruiser's destruction|<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>}}
A '''battle cruiser''' was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Khypes]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] when he was sent to [[Imperial Attack on Voss|conquer]] the recently-discovered [[Voss system/Legends|Voss system]]<ref name="Codex" /> around [[3645 BBY]].<ref name="Voss-Date" /> However, before Khypes could contact the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and demand their surrender,<ref name="Codex" /> the secretive [[Star Cabal]] used their technology to override the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] systems and caused it<ref name="Hidden Throne">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|The Hidden Throne|Isen Four}} establishes that [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] investigates all occurrences of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] spontaneously exploding via [[Hunter (Star Cabal)|Hunter's]] override technology in the last five [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and this leads [[Cipher Nine]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and [[Voss]]. Additionally, the [[Star Cabal]] sends the [[Albathius|Shining Man]] to Voss in the aftermath of the [[Invasion of Voss|invasion]], as they wish to prevent the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from controlling the world. Thus, it can be determined that the Voss invasion was also caused by the Star Cabal.</ref> to explode, and the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruiser's]] escorts were destroyed as well only moments later. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet's]] destruction, the cause of which could not be identified, shocked both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire. The Empire suspected Republic [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] or a secret Voss weapon, and the Republic theorized it was the result of infighting among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Codex" /> Both the Republic and the Empire began [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] relations with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Voss as a result, hoping to form an alliance with the [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khypes and his battle cruiser were first mentioned in the Codex entry "The Imperial Attack on Voss" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
